ExcludeDefeated.Name: No turn for defeated/dead combatants
ExcludeDefeated.Hint: Combatants marked defeated (skull) or with the Dead condition stay in the encounter (experience still counts) but get no turn and are passed over without a chat message.

HpDeath.Name: Death by hit points
HpDeath.Hint: Treat current HP at or below -Con score (0 for creatures without Con) as dead and silently exclude from turns.
HpDeath.HintGeneric: Treat the value at 'HP path' at or below 'Death HP' as dead and silently exclude from turns.

HideDeadTokens.Name: Hide dead turn-excluded tokens
HideDeadTokens.Hint: Hide the token and tracker entry of a dead (defeated marker, Dead condition or HP death threshold) turn-excluded combatant from players (GMs see it faded). Shown again when revived or no longer excluded. Only tokens this module hid are restored.

RevealOnCombatEnd.Name: Show hidden tokens when combat ends
RevealOnCombatEnd.Hint: When the encounter is deleted, show the dead tokens this module hid (e.g. for looting).

GroupSwap.Name: Pass a dead representative's turn to a living token of its kind
GroupSwap.Hint: When one token runs the initiative for a group of identical mobs and dies, move the combatant onto a living token of the same actor that is not in combat (nearest first) so the group keeps its initiative. The dead token stays as a turnless combatant for experience.

HpStates.Name: Dying/unconscious by hit points
HpStates.Hint: Negative HP without Stable counts as dying, nonlethal damage above current HP as unconscious; their turn ends automatically. Diehard/Ferocity ignore the dying check.

AutoEndTurn.Name: End turns for incapacitating conditions
AutoEndTurn.Hint: When a turn starts with a condition that prevents actions, post the reason to chat and advance the turn.

Confusion.Name: Roll confusion behaviour
Confusion.Hint: Roll the d% confusion table at the start of a confused combatant's turn; 26-50 (babble) ends the turn.

AnnounceDelay.Name: Announce delays in chat
AnnounceDelay.Hint: Post delay, delayed action and forfeited delay messages.

AutoEndPause.Name: Pause before auto end (ms)
AutoEndPause.Hint: Wait after the auto end message before advancing.

BlockingMenu.Name: Turn-ending conditions
BlockingMenu.Label: Choose conditions
BlockingMenu.Hint: Choose which conditions end a turn automatically.
BlockingMenu.Intro: A checked condition still present when the turn starts ends that turn. The list comes from the current game system; defaults are the 'can take no actions' ones (PF1: Core Rulebook Appendix 2).

HpPath.Name: HP path
HpPath.Hint: Data path of an actor's current hit points, e.g. system.attributes.hp.value (D&D 5e and others). Leave empty to disable HP checks.

HpDeathAt.Name: Death HP
HpDeathAt.Hint: Hit points at or below this value count as dead.

Condition.dying: Dying: unconscious, can take no actions. DC 10 Con check each turn to stabilize.
Condition.stunned: Stunned: can't take actions, -2 AC, loses Dex bonus.
Condition.cowering: Cowering: frozen in fear, can take no actions.
Condition.paralyzed: Paralyzed: can't move or act; purely mental actions allowed (untick if needed).
Condition.helpless: Helpless: paralyzed, bound, asleep, unconscious... usually covered by another condition.
Condition.panicked: Panicked: can only flee; the GM moves the creature.
Condition.nauseated: Nauseated: a single move action (RAW still has a turn).
Condition.staggered: Staggered: a single move or standard action (RAW still has a turn).
Condition.disabled: Disabled: a single move or standard action (RAW still has a turn).
Condition.nonlethal: Unconscious from nonlethal damage above current HP.

Chat.BlockedBody: {name} can't act and the turn passes.
Chat.DyingCheck: Stabilize this turn: DC 10 Constitution check with a {penalty} penalty (negative HP). Failure loses 1 HP; natural 20 succeeds.
Chat.DyingBleed: While taking continuous damage such as bleed, stabilization checks fail automatically and 1 extra HP is lost.
Chat.NoneCanAct: Nobody in the encounter can act, so the turn was not advanced.
Chat.ConfusionSkip: Does nothing but babble. The turn passes.
Chat.DelayLostBody: {name} reached their regular turn while delaying, loses the delayed action and acts normally (may delay again).

Confusion.Self: Deal 1d8 + Str modifier damage to self with item in hand
Confusion.Attack: Attack nearest creature (a familiar counts as self)
Confusion.Attacked: A confused creature that is attacked attacks its attackers on its next turn if still confused. If it can't carry out the result it babbles.

Warn.NoGM: No GM is connected to handle this.
Warn.DelayNotYourTurn: You can only delay on your own turn.
Warn.DelayBlocked: A creature that can't act can't delay.
Warn.NoAnchorInitiative: That combatant has no initiative to act around.

Excluded.manual: No turn (manual): stays in the encounter but gets no turn.
Excluded.hpDead: No turn: HP at or below the death threshold
